item.title: Version 1.4.4
item.description:
v1.4.4

  • Theme fidelity pass across Windows 98 / XP / 7 / 8.1 / 10 / 11: taskbar chrome, Start menus, tray clock, Jump Lists, and themed window previews.
  • Win11 notification bell opens macOS Notification Center; the badge follows Notification Center items (and clears when you clear them).
  • Win8.1 Start tiles no longer overflow the screen. XP volume popover corners match the rounded border. Removed the Win11 Widgets button and the extra stacked-window dashes.
  • Taskbar scale in 0.25 steps; enabled displays stored by UUID; per-screen auto-hide follows the screen under the mouse.
⚠️ Accessibility Permission

Builds use a stable code signature. If merge-windows / title display stop working after this update: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility → select RetroWin → −, relaunch, and Allow again. Later updates with the same signature should keep the grant.
